title: format_func does not keep the pill selected when the pill's text changes.
body:
### Checklist

- [x] I have searched the [existing issues](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues) for similar issues.
- [x] I added a very descriptive title to this issue.
- [x] I have provided sufficient information below to help reproduce this issue.

### Summary

Hi,

In the first part of the code below, two interdependent "pills" components are created; the `format_func` adjusts the text displayed on the buttons to show the record count for each category.
When a category is selected in the first component, it updates the component below by filtering subcategories and changing the displayed text to reflect the record count for each subcategory.
However, when the category selection is cleared, the second component retains the value in `session_state` and the object's internal state, yet it does not visually appear selected, which misleads the user.
In this scenario, the subcategory component should appear selected, even though the displayed text has changed.

The second part uses the "same code" but without `format_func`: here, if you select a category, select a subcategory, and then deselect the category, the subcategory remains visually selected.



```
import streamlit as st
import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame(
        [
            {"id": 1, "name":"name a","category": "A","category_b": "D"},
            {"id": 2, "name":"name b","category": "A","category_b": "D"},
            {"id": 3, "name":"name c","category": "B","category_b": "D"},
            {"id": 4, "name":"name d","category": "B","category_b": "E"},
            {"id": 5, "name":"name e","category": "C","category_b": "E"},
            {"id": 6, "name":"name f","category": "C","category_b": "F"},
            {"id": 7, "name":"name g","category": "C","category_b": "F"},
            {"id": 8, "name":"name h","category": "C","category_b": "G"},
            {"id": 9, "name":"name i","category": "C","category_b": "G"},
            {"id": 10, "name":"name j","category": "C","category_b": "H"},
        
        ]
    
    )
df_2 = df.copy()

cat = st.pills("Category",df['category'].unique(),format_func= lambda x: f'{x} ({len(df.loc[df["category"] == x])})',key='category')
if cat:
    df = df.loc[df['category'] == cat]

catb = st.pills("Category B",df['category_b'].unique(),format_func= lambda x: f'{x} ({len(df.loc[df["category_b"] == x])})',key='category_b')
if catb:
    df = df.loc[df['category_b'] == catb]
st.code(cat)
st.code(catb)
st.dataframe(df)


cat2 = st.pills("Category",df_2['category'].unique(),key='category_2')
if cat2:
    df_2 = df_2.loc[df_2['category'] == cat2]

catb2 = st.pills("Category B",df_2['category_b'].unique(),key='category_b_2')
if catb2:
    df_2 = df_2.loc[df_2['category_b'] == catb2]
st.code(cat2)
st.code(catb2)
st.dataframe(df_2)

```

![Views](https://api.views-badge.org/badge/st-issue-16269)

### Summary

This is a `st.pills` bug (also applies to `st.segmented_control`, which shares the same `ButtonGroup` implementation): when `format_func` output for the currently-selected option changes between reruns (here the record count in the label changes as `df` is filtered), the pill visually appears **deselected**, even though `session_state` and the return value still hold the correct underlying value. The reporter's second example without `format_func` works, isolating `format_func` as the trigger.

### Potential root cause

Since the 1.54 refactor, these button-group widgets identify/track the selected option by its **formatted display string** rather than by the underlying value:

- Frontend (`frontend/lib/src/components/widgets/ButtonGroup/ButtonGroup.tsx`) stores the widget value as the formatted content string and highlights selection via `contentStringsToIndices(options, value)`. When `format_func` output changes (e.g. `"D (2)"` → `"D (3)"`), the stored string no longer matches any current option's content, so `selectedKeys` is empty and nothing renders as selected.
- Backend (`lib/streamlit/elements/widgets/button_group.py`) maps wire values via `formatted_option_to_option_index`, and only preserves the *value* through `session_state_fallback` — which is why `session_state`/the return value stay correct while the visual selection is lost.

Note there is already substantial handling for dynamic `format_func`/option changes in recent versions — the `session_state_fallback` + `set_value` re-serialization added in #15522 (shipped in 1.60.0) and the dynamic-options support in #13684. The report was filed without a version, so the team should confirm the exact Streamlit version and whether this still reproduces on the latest release; this may be a remaining edge case in the interdependent (parent→child) pills flow rather than a fully open regression.

### Related Issues

- [#12392](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/12392) — State management issues with `st.pills` when options change dynamically based on a parent selection (selections get reset). Closest match: same widget and the same interdependent parent→child pattern.
- [#8008](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/8008) — `st.selectbox` returns a stale value when `format_func` output changes; same root cause of using `format_func` output as the option identity/key.
- [#14115](https://github.com/streamlit/streamlit/issues/14115) — `st.radio` returns the wrong option because (since 1.54) options are identified by their formatted display text; same family of `format_func`-as-identity bugs.
